# Una Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10-11 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P21](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0021), [v5 c4 P15](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Una is a pale, delicate girl with a small, sensitive face and dark-blue eyes that have a wistful, sorrowful expression. She has straight, dead-black hair worn in long braids, tiny white teeth, and a shy, meditative smile. She is often seen in shabby, outgrown clothing due to her family's poverty.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c9 P15](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0015), [v5 c14 P28](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0028), [v5 c24 P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 c24 P32](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0032)_

## Personality

Una is a gentle, sensitive, and deeply empathetic child who cares intensely about the well-being of her family. She is shy, timid, and easily frightened by ghosts or conflict, yet she possesses a quiet, heroic courage when those she loves are hurting. Thoughtful and devout, she takes great comfort in prayer and spiritual things, longing for a peaceful, orderly life. Unlike her more daring siblings, Una hates fisticuffs and strife, desiring only to stay at home and surround her loved ones with affection.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P53](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0053), [v5 c5 P9](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0009), [v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c5 P92](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0092), [v5 c5 P111](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0111), [v5 c5 P122](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0122), [v5 c9 P9](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0009), [v5 c9 P23](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0023), [v5 c9 P34](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0034), [v5 c17 P27](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0027), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 c35 P10](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0010)_

## History

Una Meredith grew up in the Maywater manse until the age of ten, when her father accepted a call to Glen St. Mary. Following her mother's early death, Una and her siblings lived under the haphazard care of her father and their elderly relative, Aunt Martha, leading a neglected, wild existence. Shortly after arriving in the Glen, Una and her siblings discovered Mary Vance, a runaway orphan, hiding in a barn, and helped shelter her at the manse. After Mary's terrifying tales about cruel stepmothers, Una became secretly terrified that her father would remarry. When she discovered her father's deep sorrow over a failed romance, Una heroically conquered her own fears and visited Rosemary West, begging her to marry her father to make him happy. Her selfless plea touched Rosemary, resolving the misunderstanding between the adults and paving the way for their marriage. Una also participated in the Good-Conduct Club formed with her siblings to discipline themselves, once fasting until she fainted in church. She subsequently found deep happiness in the family's union with Rosemary West.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c5 P13](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0013), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c9 P81](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0081), [v5 c14 P19](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0019), [v5 c23 P59](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0059), [v5 c28 P12](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0012), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P20](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0020), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Rev. John Knox Meredith and his deceased wife Cecilia  <sub>[v5 c2 P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c14 P19](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0019)</sub>
- Mother died when she was six years old  <sub>[v5 c4 P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052)</sub>
- Moved with her family from Maywater to the Glen St. Mary manse  <sub>[v5 c2 P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
